You are Koda. Build **Track A of Sprint 4 — Flash day events** for InkOS at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS`.

## Scope (TRACK A ONLY — do not touch booking-link hub/QR, that's Track B)

Build the **flash day event booking system** end-to-end. Pattern from Venue Ink: "Host one-off events with pre-set time slots and get instantly booked."

**Core concept:** Flash events are one-day themed events (Halloween Flash Day, Valentine's Flash, etc.) with pre-designed small tattoos that clients book at a flat rate. One event has many pre-generated slots; clients grab a slot via public page.

## CONTEXT — read first

- **CLAUDE.md** forbidden list
- **Plan Section C2** in `/Users/yashbaldha/.claude/plans/so-we-made-detailed-glistening-frost.md`
- **Competitor:** Venue Ink — `https://www.venue.ink/flash-tattoo-events` and `https://www.venue.ink/blog/plan-tattoo-flash-day`
- **Existing:**
  - Public booking flow at `app/book/[studioSlug]/*` — read `[serviceId]/page.tsx` and the deposit checkout flow to match patterns
  - `supabase/migrations/` — match SQL style
  - Dodo Payments for deposits — reuse existing `/api/public/deposits/checkout` pattern
  - `lib/supabase/types.ts` — will need updates

## 1. Schema

Migration `supabase/migrations/20260422100000_flash_events.sql`:

```sql
create table flash_events (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  studio_id uuid not null references studios(id) on delete cascade,
  artist_id uuid references artists(id) on delete set null,   -- nullable for studio-wide events
  title text not null,
  slug text not null,                                          -- URL-friendly unique per studio
  description text,
  event_date date not null,
  start_time time not null,                                    -- e.g. 10:00
  end_time time not null,                                      -- e.g. 18:00
  slot_duration_min int not null check (slot_duration_min between 15 and 480),
  slot_price_cents int not null default 0,
  deposit_cents int not null default 0,
  currency text not null default 'USD',
  max_slots int,                                               -- nullable = unlimited
  cover_image_url text,
  flyer_url text,                                              -- storage path for tattoo flash sheet PDF/image
  location_id uuid references locations(id) on delete set null,
  public boolean not null default true,
  status text not null default 'draft' check (status in ('draft','published','completed','cancelled')),
  published_at timestamptz,
  cancelled_at timestamptz,
  created_by uuid references auth.users(id) on delete set null,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique (studio_id, slug)
);

create table flash_event_designs (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  flash_event_id uuid not null references flash_events(id) on delete cascade,
  title text not null,                                         -- "Spider Web", "Black Cat"
  image_url text not null,                                     -- storage path
  size_description text,                                       -- "2 inches"
  placement_options text,                                      -- "forearm, ankle, shoulder"
  price_cents int,                                             -- override event price; nullable = use event price
  display_order int not null default 0,
  sold_out boolean not null default false,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table flash_event_slots (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  flash_event_id uuid not null references flash_events(id) on delete cascade,
  slot_start timestamptz not null,
  slot_end timestamptz not null,
  status text not null default 'open' check (status in ('open','reserved','booked','blocked')),
  booking_id uuid references bookings(id) on delete set null,
  design_id uuid references flash_event_designs(id) on delete set null,  -- optional design pre-selection
  reserved_until timestamptz,                                              -- for hold during checkout
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique (flash_event_id, slot_start)
);

-- Indexes: FKs + query paths
create index idx_flash_events_studio_date on flash_events(studio_id, event_date desc);
create index idx_flash_events_public_published on flash_events(public, status, event_date) where public = true and status = 'published';
create index idx_flash_event_designs_order on flash_event_designs(flash_event_id, display_order);
create index idx_flash_event_slots_status on flash_event_slots(flash_event_id, slot_start, status);
create index idx_flash_event_slots_booking on flash_event_slots(booking_id) where booking_id is not null;

-- RLS: standard studio-member pattern for all 3 tables
-- Additionally: public read policy on flash_events + designs + slots where flash_events.public = true AND status = 'published' (so anon public booking page can read)

-- Triggers:
-- - updated_at on flash_events
-- - when a slot is booked (status=booked, booking_id set), atomic check that slot was 'open' or 'reserved' (prevent double-book)
-- - when a flash_event is cancelled, cancel all open slots + notify booked clients (enqueue job)
```

Add a function `generate_flash_event_slots(event_id uuid)` that:
- Takes a flash event ID
- Computes time slots from start_time to end_time at slot_duration_min intervals
- Inserts `flash_event_slots` rows with status='open' for each
- Called when flash event transitions to status='published'

## 2. Lib

`lib/flash-events/queries.ts`:
- `listFlashEvents(studioId, filters?: { status?, upcoming?: boolean })`
- `getFlashEvent(studioId, id)` — with designs + slots summary
- `getFlashEventBySlug(studioSlug, eventSlug)` — for public page (no studioId auth required; only public+published visible)
- `getFlashEventSlots(studioId, eventId, { available?: boolean })`
- `getFlashEventDesigns(studioId, eventId)`

`lib/flash-events/mutations.ts`:
- `createFlashEvent(studioId, input)` — Zod validated, status='draft'
- `updateFlashEvent(studioId, id, input)`
- `publishFlashEvent(studioId, id)` — transitions draft→published, generates slots
- `cancelFlashEvent(studioId, id)` — cancels, frees slots, triggers notifications
- `addDesign(studioId, eventId, input)`
- `removeDesign(studioId, eventId, designId)`
- `reorderDesigns(studioId, eventId, orderedIds)`
- `reserveSlot(eventId, slotId, clientInfo)` — public, 15 min hold; creates bookings row in pending state + links slot
- `confirmSlotBooking(eventId, slotId, bookingId)` — post-deposit

`lib/flash-events/schemas.ts` — Zod schemas for all inputs.

## 3. Admin UI

**`app/(app)/flash-events/page.tsx`** — list page:
- Filter: upcoming / past / drafts / all
- Grid of event cards: cover image, title, date, artist, slot count (X of Y booked), status chip
- "New flash event" CTA

**`app/(app)/flash-events/new/page.tsx`** + `components/flash-events/NewFlashEventForm.tsx`:
- Multi-section form:
  - Basics: title, description, date, start/end times, slot duration, artist
  - Pricing: slot_price, deposit
  - Flash designs (optional at creation; can add later): upload images + titles + sizes
  - Publish / save draft

**`app/(app)/flash-events/[id]/page.tsx`** — detail w/ 4 tabs:
- **Overview:** date/times, stats (slots total / booked / available), publish button, cancel button
- **Designs:** grid of designs (drag-reorder), add/remove, mark-sold-out
- **Slots:** table of slots with client info + deposit status; manual block/unblock
- **Settings:** edit all fields

**`app/(app)/flash-events/[id]/edit/page.tsx`** — inline edit form

## 4. Public booking flow

**`app/book/[studioSlug]/flash/[eventSlug]/page.tsx`** — public flash event landing:
- Hero: cover image, title, date, artist, location
- Design grid (if designs exist) — click design → select → show slot picker
- Slot picker: grid of time slots (open = clickable green, reserved = gray, booked = red strikethrough)
- Click slot → client info form (name, email, phone, notes, photo ID upload if required)
- Submit → create pending booking + reserve slot (15 min hold) → redirect to Dodo deposit checkout
- On deposit success (existing webhook): slot.status='booked', booking confirmed, confirmation email/SMS sent

**`app/book/[studioSlug]/flash/[eventSlug]/confirmation/[token]/page.tsx`** — confirmation page (reuse existing booking confirmation pattern)

**Public slot reservation:** add RPC `public_reserve_flash_slot(event_slug, slot_id, client_info jsonb)` with the same pattern as `public_create_booking`.

## 5. Sidebar nav

Add Flash Events to sidebar in `components/app/sidebar/nav-config.ts`:
- Location: STUDIO group, after "Flash & Portfolio" (or integrate with it if it makes sense)
- Actually — the existing "Flash & Portfolio" nav item is for portfolio management. Flash Events is distinct: event booking. Add as a new item in STUDIO group: `Flash Events` → `/flash-events`.
- Or: merge with "Flash & Portfolio" as a tab system. Read `app/(app)/portfolio/` structure first; if it has tabs, add "Events" tab. If it's a flat page, add separate sidebar item.

## 6. Storage

Create storage bucket `flash-event-assets` in a small migration (if storage buckets are managed via SQL; otherwise document as manual Supabase dashboard step).

## 7. Quality gates

- `pnpm typecheck` clean
- `pnpm build` clean
- No `any`, no `console.log`
- All queries use studioId (except public paths which use studioSlug validation)
- Mobile responsive
- Dark mode compatible
- Atomic slot booking (use SELECT FOR UPDATE or unique constraint in trigger to prevent race double-book)

## 8. Report

- Files created/modified
- Migration path
- Public URL structure
- Any deferred features
- Typecheck + build results

Build methodically. Start by reading the existing public booking flow (`app/book/[studioSlug]/[serviceId]/page.tsx`), then the sidebar, then build schema → lib → admin UI → public flow.
